description: Add a repository as a PreviewDrop project. GitHub (default) needs the GitHub App installed on the repo owner's account — if not, use get_github_app_install_url first. GitLab and Bitbucket need the provider connected once in the dashboard under Settings → Integrations.

defaultBranch.description: Default branch to watch (defaults to main)

gitProvider.description: Git host of the repository (default: github)

githubRepo.description: Repository path, e.g. acme/my-api (GitLab subgroups allowed: group/subgroup/project)

name.description: Project display name (defaults to the repo name)

name: create_project
